_about: The path's random encounters: exactly as many good as bad (good: true or false), dealt so every two in a run hold one of each. Outcomes: mass (+ or −; a part that no longer fits falls off), gain_part (a random part up to a tier), lose_part (a random part), max_hp, heal, heal_full, hurt (never below 1 health), acorns.

encounters.name: Mossy Hollow
encounters.text: You curl up in a hollow log lined with moss. When you crawl out you are bigger than you went in.

encounters.name: A Shed Skin
encounters.text: Something left its old skin on a root, with a part still in it. It fits you.

encounters.name: Sweet Sap
encounters.text: A maple is bleeding sap. You drink until you feel sturdier.

encounters.name: Fairy Ring
encounters.text: You step into a ring of toadstools and something in you stretches.

encounters.name: A Forgotten Cache
encounters.text: Under the leaves: a squirrel's winter store, long forgotten.

encounters.name: Moonlit Pool
encounters.text: The pool is cold and very still. You rest in it until every wound has closed.

encounters.name: Bramble Thicket
encounters.text: The only way through is the brambles. They take a piece of you.

encounters.name: Hungry Heron
encounters.text: A heron strikes from the reeds and flies off with something of yours.

encounters.name: Early Frost
encounters.text: The frost comes early and gets into you. You will not be quite as hardy again.

encounters.name: Sinkmud
encounters.text: You pull yourself out of the mud, but not all of you comes out.

encounters.name: Thieving Magpie
encounters.text: A magpie lands, looks at you, and leaves with your acorns.

encounters.name: Nettle Patch
encounters.text: Nettles, as far as you can see. You go through them anyway.
